import json
# over-limit burst: 400000 packets (~11 MB)

steps=[{'t':i,'serve':True,'arrivals':[{'id':'s%d'%i,'lane':0,'rank':i%7}]} for i in range(40001)]

open('/app/dev/over_steps.json','w').write(s2)

# over-limit attempts: 20000 steps x 8 lanes = 160000 attempts
steps3=[]
c=0
for i in range(20000):
    arr=[{'id':'a%d'%(c+j),'lane':j,'rank':(c+j)%7} for j in range(8)]
